candidates.title: [Performance]: Batch-sharded sampling: NCCL point-to-point buffers take about 2.7 GiB per GPU at TP 8; NCCL_MAX_P2P_NCHANNELS limits them
candidates.snippet: ### Proposal to improve performance  `--enable-batch-sharded-sampling` exchanges vocabulary shards with one all-to-all (`all_to_all_vocab_shards`). At TP 8 on 8 x A100-40GB, the NCCL point-to-point buffers of that all-to-all take 2,730 to 2,852 MiB on each GPU with NCCL defaults, and that memory comes out of the KV cache. `NCCL_MAX_P2P_NCHANNELS=4` cuts it to 380 MiB and keeps most of the speed.  1. candidates.title: Idle-burst prefill: first request waits for the next batch (consecutive prefill overlap) and bursts are split 1+N
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  When several requests reach an idle server together, the overlap scheduler admits the first request alone. With the default consecutive-prefill overlap, that first batch's result is processed only after the next prefill batch has been launched, so the first request's TTFT becomes about two batches long. `SGLANG_DISABLE_CONSECUTIVE_PREFILL_OVERLAP=1` removes the wait. - The first request then returns about as fast as a lone one. - Median burst TTFT drops 24% at N=2 and 36% at 4096 tok

candidates.title: Qwen3: tensor-parallel gradient accumulation silently amplifies Q/K norm gradients
candidates.snippet: With tensor parallelism and gradient accumulation, `ReplicatedWithGradAllReduce` repeatedly sums gradients from earlier microbatches. Qwen3's Q/K norm gradients silently diverge from the non-TP reference even though forward losses remain close.
